title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 5–11 years (¥650bn anticipated) — the last print of this instrument before 2026-10-22, and the first read on whether August's coupon reversal was noise
source: EST: mof.go.jp English September 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2609e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,796 bytes) by the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-10-22 initial research; its table row reads 'Sep. 25, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 5-11 years)'. Terms are NOT yet announced — the Sep. 25 row carries no announcement href on 2026-09-09, consistent with MOF's own note that each issue amount is announced about one week prior (so ~2026-09-18). The ¥650bn anticipated size is MOF's own twenty-five-auction run of 'About 650 billion yen' announcements, 2024-08-22 through 2026-08-26. Independently corroborated by cadence: this zone appears in all 35 of MOF's monthly calendars 2024-01 → 2026-11 without exception. Filed `estimate` on the standing counts — size not announced, issue list unpublished, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. The DATE is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the taxonomy and the terms, not the evidence
notes: Discovered 2026-09-09 during the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-10-22 initial-research adjacency sweep, on MOF's own September calendar. It earns a slot on one specific term rather than on calendar completeness: it is the LAST observation of this instrument before 2026-10-22 and the first chance to score the coupon-preference reading that the 10-22 ledger registers. Across the 32 prints of this zone, takeup overweights high-coupon paper at matched remaining maturity — 10-year (0.87% average coupon) 0.62x its share of eligible stock, 20-year (1.26%) 1.32x, 30-year (2.26%) 1.86x, with the last five auctions at 0.36x / 1.58x / 5.05x — and the coupon-weighted overweight has been positive in 11 of the last 12 prints (mean +0.448pp, t = +5.91). THE ONE EXCEPTION IS THE MOST RECENT PRINT: on 2026-08-26 the 20-year takeup went almost entirely to the lowest-coupon issues in the band (No.155-161, coupons 0.2-1.0%), 3.2% of the 20-year take against 38.4% of the 20-year eligible stock, after 96.9 / 68.6 / 94.7 / 59.9% in the four prints before it. Two consecutive reversals would kill the reading; one more positive print restores it. That is what makes 09-25 worth a row of its own rather than a footnote. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
